comments: Great Location and smooth check in. Poor quality of furniture. The bed was not even a proper bed. Torn and broken Sofa.

excellent price in good location, has everything needed.  Owners are responsive and helpful The lock on the door sometimes doesn't work and is basically holding the door with tape...the app to enter the building also doesn't work so check in was harder.

Great location, great hosts, and great apartment with just enough space you need, especially if you are going to be out and enjoying Madrid.  Rut and Oscar were great hosts.  Between our limited Spanish and their limited English - we did just fine!
We loved staying at Rodrigos, great central location in Madrid. Best place we stayed in our 10 days between Portugal and Spain. Would return in a heartbeat. Thank you !

It was a pleasure to stay in Ricardos flat! Everything was very clean and the flat in general and the neighborhood La Latina are so nice! Ricardo gives us a lot of advices where to go in Madrid! Thank you Ricardo!

Place was spacious and clean and Patricia was kind enough to let us change our dates without penalty. Very conveniently located across from a market and many luxury shops. 3 bathrooms which was a bonus for us and quite clean.  Unfortunately the air conditioning did not working properly throughout the duration of our stay and being 40 degrees outside meant this was an issue . The unit seemed to be minimally working and this meant it wasn’t super hot rather warm without any air circulation … I did request repair but after some initial back and forth never heard back about this and no one attended during our time there. Water pressure in the showers was very low barely above a dribble at times . Lastly the wifi password provided was incorrect thus we were unable to access during our stay.

Very nice host, he waited for us at the arrival, and was very welcoming. And we were free to choose the check-out time and leave during the afternoon.The appartment is really great, clean and ideally situated. Really easy to live in! See you soon Madrid. Gracias Domingo.

Cannot say enough great things about this apartment! The location, the decor, so comfortable and the light from the balconies is amazing. Bed is so comfortable and wonderful shower, one of the most enjoyable stays we’ve had (and we’ve been traveling for more than a year so that is saying a lot!). Highly recommend!

My wife and two daughters stayed at this location for our first 2 days in Madrid. This space had everything we needed and the location is perfect. Alicia greeted us and allowed us to drop our bags off since we were a bit early for the check in time. It’s within walking distance of everything. Right around the corner is the Santa Anna plaza that has a variety of outdoor restaurants. We loved this space and location so much we tried to book it again on our last leg of our family vacation in Spain before we flew back to Orlando but it was all booked up. I checked the Airbnb calendar and this place books up well in advance. If this space is available and you are planning a trip to Madrid, book it asap.

Macarena’s place is lovely, quiet and cosy - so I got a great nights sleep in busy Madrid.  It's walking distance to centre (30 mins) or 10 minutes by subway to centre.  Had great inspiring conversations with Macarena during complimentary breakfast as we both, coincidentally, work in the same fields! - theatre!

This flat was nice. The bed was very comfortable and the location was good as it was walking distance to a lot of things. We didn't spend much time in the flat itself though because we were out most of the day and only came back to sleep and then checked out in the morning. 
 
 Melvin y Mario were really sweet - they held on to our bags after check out because as we waited for our train that night. 
 
 A couple chocolates and bottle of wine upon arrival, too. 
 
 Muchas Gracias, 
 George

Andre is a kind, caring and helpful host. The room is just as presented (photos, descriptions, location). Very conveniently located near the metro which connects both Chamartin and Atocha train stations.
José is a kind host and he will always try to help you. His apartment was clean, comfy and the air conditioner was amazing!!
The room was extremely cozy, and Jose was very helpful. I felt truly welcomed. I’ll probably book again if I return to Madrid. Thank you for such a lovely stay, Jose!

The apartment is very central, trendy and modern inside, however, has a decor of a uniquely old Spanish building. It is extremely central and is a shopping haven. The departmental stores are close by, eating joints, and public transport is very closeby. It is a very posh locality and is very safe. Fernando has been a perfect host, waiting for us and helping us even though we reached quite late at night. He was always there to help us on any query and help.  I strongly recommend this place with a very hospitable host for all to stay. I would like to stay again, in case I get an opportunity to visit Madrid.  The stay in the apartment made my stay in Madrid an extra fillip....thank you, Fernando!
Great host!  The apartment was perfect for our family of 5, very clean and in a great location!

This apartment has a unique location, the facilities are comfortable and very clean, the hosts are attentive to any questions and explain you exactly how to get in . Is the best option to stay in Madrid.

Beautifully stylish apartment in an excellent location, only metres from Bilbao metro station and minutes from the heart of Chueca.  Although it's in a lively area, the apartment was quiet. Mariola was the perfect host with prompt communication and easy check in. Recommended.

The apartment was ideally situated in the centre of Madrid: close to the metro, supermarket and Plaza Mayor/Puerta del Sol. We did a lot by foot. Quick communication.  We had a wonderful stay in Madrid!
Loved staying here. Great for solo travelers. Clean, cute apartment in a great neighborhood. Would absolutely stay here again. Carmen is helpful and responsive, had no problems at all.
Carmen is a gracious and wonderful hostess. She goes out of her way to make guests feel at home and comfortable. Highly recommend!

A beautiful apartment steps from the Plaza Mayor.  Pictures and description are very accurate.  Three small balconies with room for two small chairs each.  Great for people watching and wine sipping.   Highly recommended.

Cannot beat the convenience of a central location.  Plaza Mayor is visible from the the balcony and observing the throngs of tourists flowing by provides endless entertainment.  The apartment is modern and provided enough space for my wife and I.  The Sol metro station is a short walk from the apartment and numerous dining and shopping options are nearby.  The hosts were fantastic and interested in making sure our stay was enjoyable.  The hosts own a cafe a few meters from the apartment that offers great breakfast selections and coffee.  We  had a wonderful stay in Madrid and highly recommend the property.

My gosh, this place was perfect for the two of us! The bed was comfortable and the place had everything we needed! We loved going to sleep with the sounds of nightlife and waking to the sound of a new day downtown. We loved how close to city center we were and how so many sights could be reached on foot. There also was a plethora of places nearby to eat and shop - the laminated recommendations and instructions were very helpful. Finally being able to leave our things at the creperie downstairs after checkout was just such icing on the crepe. The convenience of having our accommodations so close made our days here so beautiful!

Very good value. You’ll meet the host in person to go over the basics. If your Spanish is limited like mine, it pays to have a translate app handy. There is a parking space included - no space wasted down there so stay alert. It’s a short walk from the metro - and driving in downtown Madrid is very stressful - so skip the car if you can. Overall a very good experience.
Super helpful, met us at the door. Recommended a mall and some local spots to check out. Everything was easy.
Wonderful stay and Raul was very easy to communicate with.  He was a great host - would definitely recommend!

We had a great 10 days in this apartment. The location is incredible (near to shops and restaurants) and communication beforehand with Javier was great. The space is really cute and clean, we did find that we had to sleep in separate locations as the bed is quite narrow (we are reasonably tall). However the sofa bed is exceptionally comfortable. Definitely would stay here again.

The apartment needs some TLC as we had a few minor issues which was solved on the same day The location however could not be better or centrical for Madrid. Shops, bars, restaurants and metro all in walking distance. However would not recommend for anyone with mobility issues because of a spiral staircase you need to climb to get access to the main floor and anyone over 6 feet tall as this apartment has been converted from an attic and the wooden beams from the ceiling are to low especially in the bedroom.

The flat is beautifully presented and very conveniently located. Lola was very attentive replying to questions promptly. It is in an old building although the flat itself recently decorated. Thus, the noises can be heard from next room or even upstairs.
Very nice house. The house was new and clean. Nice hosting. If you prefer a calm place than a noise(downtown), i really recommend you here. Near from sol. Very good to take bus,metro or taxi.

We stayed in the apartment for 3 nights and we were really satisfied. Location of the flat is in the very centre and close to the nearest metro station. Nearby are also grocery shops, pharamacy, fast foods. Absolutly recommend for all the travelers into Madrid. Owner of the flat was answering almost immediately and he was flexible and helpful about our arrival. Thank you!
Location was perfect, the Place was a little bit small and sofa bed not really comfortable but overall a nice stay
Tobias was a fab host. went above and beyond to help us with our needs for our stay. Great central location for walks and to metro lines to all the tourist attractions. Thanks Tobias!

I booked in this neighborhood to be close to a concert but it was a great place to walk around! There is a supermarket and a ton of bars and restaurants nearby and I felt safe. The place was clean and comfy--there are multiple units in a divided suite but you have everything you need including a shower that felt great after flying and a nice little kitchen. If you have a rental car you will need to park in a nearby garage but that seems to be the case everywhere.

We feel so lucky to have found Carlos and his home. This is the 2nd time our family has stayed with him. We feel like Carlos’ home is our home in Madrid. We have two kids under 10 and we feel so safe and well taken care of that we won’t stay anywhere else when we visit Madrid. You simply can’t ask for a more thorough and sincere host, and such a well appointed, comfortable and clean apartment. Thank you so much Carlos, can’t wait to be back!!
Stylish, comfortable loft very conveniently located within walking distance to many sights in Madrid. We had a great stay and would recommend this airbnb.

Great location! Taxi will drop you off in front of door. You may even ask the taxi to take you to the lockers where you will pick up the keys. For us it wasn’t an inconvenience. We enjoyed out stay and we really would like to come back and keep enjoying Madrid! Host was very responsive. No issues during our stay. Very clean and practical.

The apartment is in a great neighborhood, not even a two minute walk to Cava Baja with w Great restaurant es and tapas bars. 5 min walk to Plaza Major.  The apartment had everything we needed. With two bedrooms and two baths. One was attached to one bedroom, the other was in the hallway across the second bedroom. One bedroom had an AC the other a ceiling fan, and in the living room there was another AC until which kept the apartment cool during a very hot August month. The apartment is on the top floor and has an elevator, which was wonderful. The kitchen, although small, had everything needed in there, including a washing machine.  We would definitely come back and stay in this part of town. Which is close to everything we needed and in walking distance to tourist interests.

Marta is a very nice host, she waited us in the apartment and gave us detailed instructions on facility usage and even advice of sightseeing. The apartment is just looks like the pic on bnb, all the facilities are new and clean. It's really a cozy place. There are 2 metro lines nearby and easy to connect with all the main places. And, walk is also possible as it is in the center and walking itself is the Best way to know the city. The is a supermarket, carrefour, within about 200 meters and lots of restaurant around the building, suitable for travelling with family and friends. Highly recommend!

David place is very spacious, clean and welcoming. I had a great stay from the easy checking (face to face ), tips and guide about the surroundings blocks and fast response.  The apartment is located in a quite street but just a few minutes walk from bars, cafes and shopping area.  Thanks again !

My stay at Manuela’s apartment was amazing! She is a great host and the apartment is very comfortable. Situated at the heart of a very lively neighborhood Manuela’s apartment is a quiet oasis. Would come back any day.

Maria Luis was a very good host. The apartment really nice , clean, quiet and the top in the cherry is that is very close to everything. Even though you are at the downtown area and Chueca , the apartment is really quiet.

Thank you Ana for making our quick stay in Madrid amazing. The apartment was a great location where we could walk to any food, shopping and tourist locations. Everything in the apartment was just like the pictures or better. Ana went above and beyond to let us drop off our luggage early, show us the features of the apartment, give us recommendations for food and things to do and help us with a taxi when it was time to leave. We would definitely recommend staying in this apartment.

This is our first airbnb experience  and it was a great one. Our family enjoyed our stay at Ana's place. The location is perfect, the place is clean and more than big enough for four people.  We highly recommend this place. Ana is a super host, very attentive/responsive, we were very well taken of. If there is any issue, reach out to her right away and she will make sure to resolve it.  Thank you!

Great location, big space and flows well.   Very comfortable stay.  Cute touches throughout.  Clara went out of her way to give us tips for places and she even organized the taxi ride for us the morning we went to the airport.  Superb!

We had a great stay at this apartment! It’s very comfortable and exactly as shown in the photos – everything matched the listing perfectly. The neighborhood is excellent, with plenty of supermarkets, shops, and restaurants nearby. It’s very easy to get around on foot, and there are at least two metro stations within a short walking distance. The host was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely stay here again!

The apartment is fine . The area is a little noisy from the street, and it’s in an area that’s not  Great ...it’s okay ....just its not the most sophisticated area . A good 24 h Supermarket is very close.

This apartment was beautiful  and well decorated. Everything looked new and clean. Our hosts were friendly, helpful and worked with us when our arrival time was delayed. There are places to eat nearby and the neighborhood seemed nice.  Many of the things to see and do in Madrid are a short cab/uber or bus ride away.   It was hot (39C/102F) while we were visiting so we stayed out of the afternoon heat as much as possible by visiting some of the great museums around Madrid.
Great location.  Everything within walking distance.   Comfortable space for 6.   Modern decor was pleasing.  Very clean and well kept. Would recommend to travelers considering a trip to Madrid.

Beautiful room in a beautiful old building. The location is wel connected to the metro and has plenty of places for food and drinks around. Because it's an old building be mindfull of noise you make to your neighbours. Álvaro is a gracious host and made sure we had everything we needed. Responsive and flexible when we needed him. 5 stars!
The apartment is in great location, walkable to many places and super close to the metro. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable, we had a great time

The apartment is perfect for two people, it is small and cosy, but has everything you need for a shorter stay. It is perfectly situated in the city, close to the city center and everything within walking distance. Sara is also very helpful and easy to contact.

Lovely, spacious, older apartment.  Comfly bed. Wifi works well. Great location....just a 4min walk from the HSLU and UN Tourism university building. Nice restaurants nearby. Bathroom ceiling had water damage from the apartment above, but that is getting fixed. Host gave info proactively and was solution oriented.   I would stay here next time I am here in Madrid.

Great host who was very fast to respond to any questions and told us everything to get in and made us feel right at home! Great place for a group of friends to go out and enjoy the beauty of Madrid and have a comfortable and clean place to sleep and start each day!

Everything functioned well! It was very pleasant that Jose met us in person even if we arrived at 1 am. Communication was good and Jose’s place was very freshly decorated and furnished. The location is very central and there are tons of restaurants close by. I can recommend this Airbnb for other couple travellers.

We had a great time here, it was perfectly located for us, close to the metro and easy to navigate. The host was helpful from start to finish and we couldn't have asked for more really! I travelled with two others and we have all said how good it was! Very happy we booked this place

Alfonso’s apartment was perfect for our group.  The location was excellent and the apartment very clean, comfortable and well laid out.  We couldn’t have had a better location for a wonderful stay in Madrid. Thank you!

We had a fantastic stay at this centrally located Airbnb in Madrid. The apartment was spotless, with everything we needed, including a washer and dryer, which was a huge plus for our family. The host was incredibly responsive and welcoming, and the check-in and orientation were seamless. We were able to walk everywhere from this ideal location, and the view from the bedrooms was absolutely beautiful. It was the perfect home base for exploring the city. We highly recommend it. Wonderful hospitality all around. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing host. Was a very enjoyable experience and she was super nice and responsive to all of my needs.

The apartment is in the best location. I’ve been to Madrid before and this is the best location. Perfect for two to three people. Walking distance to all of the places you must see in Madrid! Pablo and Endry are very responsive and ready to answer any questions. Thank you for everything!

We had a great stay at Oscar's apartment. Perfect location, right in the city center and walking distance from most of the places we wanted to visit. The place is super clean and the communication with the host was very smooth. I will certainly stay there again at my next visit to Madrid!
A short stay but very worth it. Oscar and the team were very helpful. In a spot in Madrid. Highly recommend!
Perfect location for a few days exploring Madrid. We could walk everywhere and easy access to the metro. Apartment was clean and as shown in pictures. We really enjoyed our stay!

Thank you. The apartment is great, nicely decorated, very clean. It has everything you need. The apartment’s windows face inner yard, you don’t hear the noice from the street, although you can hear all the neighbours very well:) (watching the tv, talking…)
Great place located walking distance from the city Center. The place is great, just as shown in the pictures. I’d like to thank Ana for being a great host and her hospitality.
Beautiful apartment in an amazing location. Extremely responsive to any question you may have and somewhere I would love to stay again.

Thank you for a beautiful stay right off Plaza Mayor. In the middle of all of the action. Very responsive host when we had a heating issue and door knob issue. People were sent within the hour. Spotless and very spacious apartment. As mentioned there were numerous flights of stairs, which were fine for us, but might be an issue with others. Lots of bars and restaurants right outside the door.

Excellent clean and modern renovated place within an older historical building. The bed rise to the ceiling and you can pull it down for the night. The washroom is well equipped with great hairdryer, various amenities and even tissues and q-tips.

We had a good stay at Beky's place. Couple of young kids came to meet us and showed us in. They were very sweet. When we asked for an extra set of keys, they were immediately dropped off. I guess the only thing that we didn't realise that there were no windows out onto the street, they were all internal windows onto light wells. Having said that, there was enough light coming in and the apartment was quiet. Metro was only a short walk away.

Great apartment, as described; clean, comfortable and well equipped. Location is perfect with lots of bars & restaurants on the doorstep but not noisy inside. Sloping ceiling is quite low on one side of the bedroom, not a big issue but if you are v tall, worth noting! Good there is a lift for the 5th floor!
Very central.  Well located to all aspects of Madrid. Secure and safe. Only downside was noise as on street level but common place throughout Madrid.
Host were very nice and helpful, just as the place itself. Easy check in, clear instructions.

I had a wonderful 10-day stay at Jose’s place. Jose and his mother were absolutely amazing hosts—so warm, kind, and welcoming. Jose was very helpful throughout my stay and made sure I had everything I needed. The space was comfortable, and I felt completely at home the entire time. I truly appreciated their hospitality and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommend!

Our stay was great! It felt like home. It’s a great place to use to explore the city, cook a few meals, relax, and use as a base to explore day trips to Toledo or other areas. We would absolutely recommend and stay here again when in Madrid!

Nurias place is one of the best Air Bnbs I have stayed in. We were a family of 4 and it was a big place really comfortable for us. They gave us 2 key sets which was really helpful. everything was spotlessly clean and kitchen was fully stocked. Will highly recommend this place for families.
Excellent room with private bath. Cristina  has been an excellent host. Valdebebas is a modern district, well connected with parking and all facilities needed.
This is a very nice apartment (well-laid out, comfortable, and clean) in a popular area near numerous attractions.

Good value for the money. The place is spotless and has all ammenities. Not to mention it is in an ideal location. Everything is in walking distace. Perfect for a place to crash, reload and then start exploring again. Raul was available as indicated via Airbnb, the instructions and infos were clear, detailed, exactly what was needed.

Had an issue with boiler. Not hot water on arrival. Host messaged me back instantly and had it fixed within the day. Other than that great location and stay. Would recommend to anyone travelling to Madrid. The metro is literally outside the front door

We absolutely loved our stay here! In a beautiful location just a short walk from loads of attractions. It was super easy to locate from the airport (just a 30 minute metro journey) and was a great airbnb that served us well! One of the more equipped airbnbs I’ve been in before (lots of kitchen appliances and spare towels, etc).
We loved our stay here. It was super clean, comfortable, well-furnished, conveniently located, easy to find, etc. Would definitely stay here again.
Our favorite part of the space was the location,  it had walkable access to all the areas we wanted to see yet removed from busy city streets. Would stay here again!
Very smooth and easy stay. Oscar’s made sure I had everything I needed. Wonderful host, and wonderful stay!
We enjoyed our st y in Juan José s place, the location is perfect, easy and safe to walk around in the park night. The apartment is nice, super well equipped, and very clean.
Great location. Central to everything.  Size of the place is huge.  Great stay.
Apartment is clean and modern, nicely decorated, great bathroom. The location is as central as you can be, which also means the street can be a bit loud at night. Overall a great stay. Thanks!
A lovely stay at Gestion’s apartment! The place is so chic & beautifully decorated, and walking distance to everything you need. Would happily come again
It was a pleasant place.  it has fulfilled  all our expectations. We definitely recommend it.
J place is a great to relax and enjoy the area around his place, there are restaurants, supermarkets, coffee shops, fruits shops that you can get anytime thanks so much for everything…
This is spacious apartment in a lovely walkable neighborhood. Metro lines are nearby to explore Madrid. Definitely would recommend.
Great stay at Javi’s place, he was very proactive with communication. Being a bigger group the space fit for our needs perfectly. Gracias Javi!
It is a nice place close to public transport.there are markets nearby. Clean and nice place with all kitchen stuff. I enjoyed
Luis' place was perfect for my two day stay in NYC. Luis was extremely helpful and the stay was perfect. Location is perfect and the little balcony was great. Highly highly recommend!
Good location, clean home! Host is always responsive. I only spent a night sleeping but I had a good night sleep… thank you! Gracias ❤️
Flat was just as described. Everything was clean and the kitchen was well equipped with the basics for cooking and making coffee  I can highly recommend this apartment and would book again!

Good as a base in Madrid, well connected by metro and a park nearby. The flat is modern, well equipped and has self controlled heating for the colder nights. I liked the keyless entry system and although there were some problems with the main entrance of the building, these were fixed promptly. The host is professional and has an always available helpline that works very well. Instructions and communication are clear and helpful.

Great stay.  Loved this new apartment.  It was very clean, with everything needed.  Great access to metro and busses.  Walkable too.  Access to great supermarkets. Great host that communicates well and punctually.
Very nice room, very good towels and bed sheets, it’s like a hotel but very comfortable for 1 or 2 people
Raul is very responsive and was a great host! The flat itself is located very close to the train station and about a 15-25 minute walk to most all of the tourist spots.
